title: Comparisons With Prior Vehicles
summary: This topic centers on customers comparing the G60 with prior vehicles across performance, comfort, technology, features, and convenience, with most examples lacking enough context for a clear sentiment label.

positive.summary: Positive feedback mentions stronger horsepower versus a prior 540i.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mix favorable and unfavorable comparisons to prior vehicles on performance, ride, comfort, audio, technology learning, and missing controls, but the sample does not provide enough context to classify them reliably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are brief comparison statements about prior vehicles and do not provide enough context for confident sentiment classification.
The topic mixes several different comparison subjects, including performance, comfort, technology, ride quality, audio, appearance, and feature availability, rather than one single coherent issue.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so these examples should not be treated as prevalence estimates for the broader vehicle population.
